meaning:
μεθύσκω
[in LXX: Psa.23:5 (רָוָה), Pro.4:17 (שָׁתָה), etc. ;]
causal of μεθύω,
to make drunk, intoxicate; pass., to get drunk: Luk.12:45, Eph.5:18, 1Th.5:7.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My lord delays his coming,’ and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink, and to be…
Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,
For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.
with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality. Those who dwell in the earth were made drunken with the wine of her sexual immorality.”
